_comment: Hand-written WRONG or UNSUPPORTED claims (not from an LLM). Citations point at the real span the claim twists, so they get the same premise as real claims. Gold labels in labels.csv.

claims.claim: httpx has three different types of timeouts: connect, read, and write.
claims.citation: There are four different types of timeouts that may occur.

claims.claim: If httpx is unable to connect within the connect timeout, a ReadTimeout exception is raised.
The httpx pool timeout specifies the maximum duration to wait for data to be sent.
claims.citation: The pool timeout specifies the maximum duration to wait for acquiring a connection from the connection pool.

claims.claim: In httpx, the maximum number of allowable connections in the connection pool is configured by the timeout argument.
claims.citation: which is configured by the `limits` argument

claims.claim: The default httpx timeout is 5 seconds.
claims.citation: HTTPX also allows you to specify the timeout behavior in more fine grained detail.

claims.claim: In httpx, the connect timeout defaults to 60 seconds.
claims.citation: The connect timeout specifies the maximum amount of time
